lesson.title: Solving simultaneous equations by elimination
lesson.purpose: Solve small coupled linear equations using justified elimination and check against the original equations.
lesson.scope: Translate supplied relationships into a system; equation and augmented-matrix forms; reversible elementary row operations; two unknowns first and one guided three-unknown example; back substitution.
lesson.boundary: No general-purpose algorithm implementation or unqualified division by a coefficient that may be zero. Introduce row exchange explicitly.
lesson.practiceAndEvidence: Move from worked to partially completed to independent two-unknown systems; carry out a guided three-unknown solution; substitute into every original equation and explain preservation of solutions.
lesson.visualPlan: Aligned equations and row operations; intersecting lines for the two-unknown case.
lesson.handover: L04 handles cases in which elimination does not produce one unique answer; L06 samples independent reasoning.
